hero.lead: Over 10 years designing digital products. Always starting with the right question.
hero.description: My name is Ademir Patrício. I'm a product designer with a front-end development background. Currently based in Recife, Brazil. Available for jobs, freelance work and remote opportunities.

trajectory.title: How I got here.
trajectory.p1: I started as a graphic designer in 2009, in the marketing department at Uninassau, shortly before finishing my degree in Advertising. I came to understand that the way things look changes what people think of them.
trajectory.p2: Not long after, I started studying web design and front-end, and was invited to join the institution's technology team. That is where I began to understand how things work and how they are designed.
trajectory.p3: Over time, the work got more complex. In 2018, at Serttel, I worked on Recife's Zona Azul Digital parking app. Urban mobility with a real problem, real scale and results to measure. That is where the kind of work I want to do became clear.
trajectory.p4: In 2019 I co-founded <malabares>Malabares MKT</malabares>. I learned to work on both sides: from concept to code. That changed how I work. I design knowing how it will be built.
trajectory.p5: Today I work as a product designer at GoExplosion and keep building my own projects. The next step is to collaborate with global teams on products that deserve to exist.

lines: Only what deserves to exist, exists.

understand.title: Understand before designing
understand.description: Before proposing any solution, I ask what needs solving and for whom. Understanding first takes a little more time and saves a lot of rework.

code.title: Design with code in mind
code.description: Because I also build, I know what each decision costs to implement. That leads me to propose solutions the team can actually deliver.

lasting.title: Build products to last
lasting.description: I think about what happens after delivery. Reusable components and a design system keep the product ready to grow without starting over.

goexplosion.description: Product design, internal systems and conversion pages for an info-product platform. A bridge between design and engineering.

malabares.description: From brief to code. Design, development and digital strategy for small and medium businesses.

crope.description: Institutional visual communication across digital channels and events.

serttel.description: Urban mobility. I took part in conceiving Recife's Zona Azul Digital parking app. From prototyping to validation with real users.

gruposer.description: Digital products for education. Institutional websites and visual consistency.

early.description: Naips Technology, Icorp, Trupe, Faculdade Nassau. Web, graphic and interface design.
